name: The Deserters
summary: Reethe has been driven from the deserter band, and Balos Jacken calls him a coward. Jacken asks you to forget the meeting. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore is waiting to hear about Reethe.

sections.title: Thrown Out
sections.body: Balos Jacken says the deserters drove Reethe out for repeatedly plundering the ogres’ stores at Brackenwall Village. The band is too small to face those ogres, he says, and Reethe crossed the line once too often. They left Reethe to manage alone. In return for the answer, Jacken asks you to forget the meeting.

sections.title: Back in Theramore
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes says Lieutenant Caldwell will be sent against the Lost Point deserters and told to find Reethe as well. Vimes judges that the marsh is neither large nor trackless enough to keep Caldwell from finding Reethe.

faq.q: Why was Reethe thrown out of the deserter camp?
aliases: why did balos kick out reethe
faq.answer: Jacken says Reethe kept plundering the ogres’ stores at Brackenwall Village. The deserters are too few to face them, so they left Reethe to manage alone.
Balos Jacken leads the Lost Point deserters. When asked about Reethe, he calls him a coward.

faq.q: Who wants to hear about Reethe?
aliases: where to turn in the deserters
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore wants to hear about Reethe. Jacken hopes you will forget you ever met the deserters.
